name: FitTribe
description: FitTribe is a holistic wellbeing tracker wrapped in a cozy, panda-themed jungle. We started with a simple question: "What if fitness wasn't intimidating?" Instead of intense leaderboards, we built a digital campfire. Track everything from powerlifting to painting in a shared space that rewards consistency over intensity.

paragraphs: FitTribe is an open-source, AI-powered holistic wellbeing and fitness tracking platform built with React 19, Supabase, and Google Gemini AI. Designed as a "digital campfire" for close-knit communities, FitTribe goes beyond traditional workout trackers by gamifying both physical fitness (strength training, cardio) and mental wellness (creativity, meditation, cooking) in a cozy, panda-themed interface.

Whether you are looking for an open-source alternative to standard fitness apps, a gamified habit tracker, or a reference architecture for building offline-first PWAs with React and Supabase, FitTribe has you covered.
